name: taskboard-desktop
description: Taskboard as a Mac app: a window onto the local Taskboard server, with a Dock badge, a menu-bar item and a global shortcut.

scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && node scripts/make-icons.cjs && electron-packager . Taskboard --platform=darwin --arch=$(node -p process.arch) --icon=build/icon.icns --out=out --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.taskboard.desktop --ignore='^/out' --ignore='^/scripts' --ignore='^/node_modules' --ignore='^/build/icon' --prune=false
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm install-app
